title: ModernELECTRA: Replaced-Token Detection with Boundary-Window Reconstruction for Compact Encoders that Classify and Embed
abstract: arXiv:2611.31495v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: ELECTRA-style replaced-token detection (RTD) is a sample-efficient objective for pre-training text encoders, and RTD-trained models such as DeBERTaV3 are strong on classification benchmarks. The same models, however, are known to be poor backbones for embedding tasks such as retrieval and semantic similarity: the binary "original vs. replaced" signal does not ask the final layer to retain the token identity and contextual content that dense representations rely on. We introduce ModernELECTRA, a pre-training recipe that keeps RTD as the main objective and adds a lightweight auxiliary task, boundary-window reconstruction. For every token, we sample a window of 3-12 tokens that strictly contains it and reconstruct the token's original identity only from the discriminator's hidden states at the two window boundaries. The task costs one small FFN at training time and is discarded afterwards, yet it forces every final-layer state to carry info

translated_title: ModernELECTRA：面向分类与嵌入的紧凑编码器的替换词元检测与边界窗口重建
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.31495v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：ELECTRA式的替换词元检测（RTD）是一种用于预训练文本编码器的高样本效率训练目标，采用RTD训练的模型（如DeBERTaV3）在分类基准测试中表现优异。然而，众所周知，这类模型作为骨干网络在检索和语义相似度等嵌入任务上表现不佳：二元的“原始词元 vs. 替换词元”信号并未要求最终层保留稠密表示所依赖的词元身份和上下文内容。我们提出了ModernELECTRA，这是一种预训练方案，它将RTD保留为主要目标，并增加了一个轻量级辅助任务——边界窗口重建。对于每个词元，我们采样一个严格包含该词元的3至12个词元的窗口，仅从判别器在窗口两个边界处的隐藏状态来重建该词元的原始身份。该任务在训练时只需额外添加一个小型前馈网络（FFN），训练结束后即被丢弃，但它能迫使每个最终层状态携带信息……
tldr: ModernELECTRA提出了一种预训练方案，在保留替换词元检测（RTD）主目标的同时，引入轻量级的边界窗口重建辅助任务，使紧凑编码器既能擅长分类任务，又能胜任检索与语义相似度等嵌入任务。
en_tdlr: ModernELECTRA introduces a pre-training recipe that keeps replaced-token detection as the main objective and adds a lightweight boundary-window reconstruction auxiliary task, enabling compact encoders to excel at both classification and embedding tasks such as retrieval and semantic similarity.
